attempts.diagnosis: In PositiveSet.find, the loop invariant `forall j::(0<=j< i) ==> x != store[j]` accesses `store[j]` without a preceding bounds invariant. Dafny cannot prove `j < store.Length` from `0 <= j < i` because `i` is not related to `nelems` or `store.Length`, so the invariant's array access is not well-formed at loop entry. The missing bounds invariant is `0 <= i <= nelems`.
